name: WCORR-SSH-001: Brute-force followed by authentication from the same IP
description: Detects an SSH brute-force alert followed by successful authentication on the same Wazuh agent within 15 minutes.
query:
sequence by agent.id.keyword, data.srcip.keyword with maxspan=15m
  [any where
    rule.id.keyword in ("5712", "5763") and
    data.srcip.keyword != null
  ]
  [any where
    rule.id.keyword == "5715" and
    data.srcip.keyword != null
  ]
author: Wazuh EQL Correlation
false_positives: Same agent and source IP do not prove account compromise or matching usernames: failures use data.srcuser and successes data.dstuser. An unrelated success from another IP cannot complete the sequence.
setup: Collect SSH brute-force and successful authentication alerts with populated native source IP and agent join fields.
